parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Group 2 nitrates decompose when heated.

Write an equation for the decomposition of strontium nitrate.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe and explain how the thermal stability of Group 2 nitrates changes with increasing atomic number.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem: The variation in the thermal stability of Group 2 amides is similar to that of Group 2 nitrates.
parts.text: Suggest whether calcium amide, $\text{Ca(NH}_2\text{)}_2$, will decompose more or less readily than barium amide, $\text{Ba(NH}_2\text{)}_2$. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
$\text{Ba(NH}_2\text{)}_2$ decomposes when heated to form barium nitride, $\text{Ba}_3\text{N}_2$, and ammonia as the only products.

Write an equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
$\text{Ba(NH}_2\text{)}_2$ contains the $\text{NH}_2^-$ ion.

Predict the bond angle of $\text{NH}_2^-$. Explain your answer using the qualitative model of electron-pair repulsion.
